transcription.assignmentSource: xuan-ib/latest.html, the published 2026-09-11 AM edition, pane p2 table 'AI 压力敞口 · §0-C'
transcription.note: Every number in this file was read out of an already-published, already-approved artefact. The three standard ladders are transcribed from the owner-reviewed §0-C table in the authority review; every per-instrument assignment and every ETF look-through percentage is transcribed from the AI-pressure table of the published report named above. Nothing here is a new financial judgement, a new coefficient, a new tier, a new account scope or a trading authority.
transcription.effective: This file has no effect until the repository owner posts the exact-head-SHA approval comment on the pull request that introduces it and that pull request merges. Until then it is a reviewed proposal only.
transcription.unresolved: The published report states a low/mid/high ladder only for the three standard tiers and for the named IREN exception. It publishes a single composition percentage for each ETF look-through and a single mid-scenario ratio. Low and high are therefore genuinely undefined for ETF look-through, and this file records that as unresolved rather than filling it with a guess or a zero.

instrumentBinding.source: the instrumentId each constituent carries in the published 2026-09-17 PM edition manifest (xuan-ib-ai-tier-records-v1); the same values were published for the same positions on every edition since 2026-09-11 PM
instrumentBinding.note: Every stock, ETF look-through and special-case entry is bound to the Sharesight instrument id its raw payload publishes. The reader resolves a constituent by (custodian, instrumentId) first, by (custodian, symbol) second, and by the same instrument recorded under another custodian third, so one custodian's spelling of a ticker (BRK.B versus BRK/B) can no longer hide an already-published tier from a run, and a company already tiered in one account does not receive a different coefficient in another. No coefficient changed.
instrumentBinding.activation: No effect until the repository owner posts the exact-head-SHA approval comment on the pull request that introduces it and that pull request merges.

T3.definition: Adopts AI but does not depend on AI capex.

stocks.note: The published 2026-09-11 AM edition printed this IB-HK position as BRK.B (IB spelling); the Sharesight IB-HK book that feeds the risk universe spells the same instrument BRK/B. From 2026-09-11 PM to 2026-09-17 PM the symbol lookup therefore missed this entry and the position was automatically classified T1 (80%) instead of the published T3 (5%). The binding is the instrument id, which both spellings share with the Schwab-HK entry, so neither spelling can fall through to the automatic policy again.
